description: Land Title Settlement Department - Maligathenna, Kandy Four Gravets D/S Division, Kandy District Cad. Map No. 320290 and 07 other declarations
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and encumbrances. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property ownership matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). There are no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other non-land related administrative matters present.
